name: Investment Restrictions 3
definition: Investment restrictions linked to the trading of an investment fund, or an alternative/hedge fund.

MinimumInitialSubscriptionAmount.name: Minimum Initial Subscription Amount
MinimumInitialSubscriptionAmount.definition: Minimum initial quantity of securities, expressed as an amount, that must be purchased at subscription.

MinimumInitialSubscriptionUnits.name: Minimum Initial Subscription Units
MinimumInitialSubscriptionUnits.definition: Minimum initial number of units/shares that must be purchased.

MinimumSubsequentSubscriptionAmount.name: Minimum Subsequent Subscription Amount
MinimumSubsequentSubscriptionAmount.definition: Minimum quantity of securities, expressed as an amount, that must be purchased.

MinimumSubsequentSubscriptionUnits.name: Minimum Subsequent Subscription Units
MinimumSubsequentSubscriptionUnits.definition: Minimum quantity of securities, expressed as number of units/shares that must be purchased.

MaximumRedemptionAmount.name: Maximum Redemption Amount
MaximumRedemptionAmount.definition: Maximum quantity of securities, expressed as an amount, that can be sold.

MaximumRedemptionUnits.name: Maximum Redemption Units
MaximumRedemptionUnits.definition: Maximum number of shares/units that may be redeemed on a single dealing day.

MinimumRedemptionPercentage.name: Minimum Redemption Percentage
MinimumRedemptionPercentage.definition: Minimum percentage of holding that may be redeemed.

OtherRedemptionRestrictions.name: Other Redemption Restrictions
OtherRedemptionRestrictions.definition: Specifies any other restrictions that may limit an investor's ability to redeem.

MinimumSwitchSubscriptionAmount.name: Minimum Switch Subscription Amount
MinimumSwitchSubscriptionAmount.definition: Minimum quantity of securities, expressed as an amount, that must be purchased.

MinimumSwitchSubscriptionUnits.name: Minimum Switch Subscription Units
MinimumSwitchSubscriptionUnits.definition: Minimum quantity of securities, expressed as number of units/shares that must be purchased.

MaximumSwitchRedemptionAmount.name: Maximum Switch Redemption Amount
MaximumSwitchRedemptionAmount.definition: Maximum quantity of securities, expressed as an amount, that can be sold.

MaximumSwitchRedemptionUnits.name: Maximum Switch Redemption Units
MaximumSwitchRedemptionUnits.definition: Maximum number of shares/units that may be redeemed on a single dealing day.

OtherSwitchRestrictions.name: Other Switch Restrictions
OtherSwitchRestrictions.definition: Specifies any other restrictions that may limit an investor's ability to switch.

MinimumHoldingAmount.name: Minimum Holding Amount
MinimumHoldingAmount.definition: Minimum value of units that must be maintained to avoid automatic redemption.

MinimumHoldingUnits.name: Minimum Holding Units
MinimumHoldingUnits.definition: Minimum number of units that must be maintained to avoid automatic redemption.

MinimumHoldingPeriod.name: Minimum Holding Period
MinimumHoldingPeriod.definition: Description of the period, that may be a number of days or weeks or another way of describing the period, during which the units/shares must be held following their issue before redemption will be permitted.

HoldingTransferable.name: Holding Transferable
HoldingTransferable.definition: Specifies how registered investors are able to transfer some or all of their holdings to third parties.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the investment restrictions.
